events.title: Distress call — Kestrel
events.description: A repeating automated call on an old civilian band. The hull is intact. Nobody is answering.

options.label: Dock and board
options.outcome: The airlock cycles on emergency power. The crew took the lifeboats; they did not take the reactor.

navos.text: Life support reads zero. That is not a good sign, Captain.

options.log_text: Boarded the Kestrel. Empty. Reactor still warm.

options.label: Log it and move on
options.outcome: You mark the position and burn away. The signal keeps repeating behind you.

navos.text: Position logged. Whoever they were, they are not our problem.

options.log_text: Left the Kestrel where it lay.

log.title: The Kestrel
log.text: Answered a distress call at the graveyard's edge.

events.notes: First contact with the salvager faction. Keep it quiet — no combat here.

events.title: The bait
events.description: Two hulls detach from the debris field the moment your clamps let go.

inside.text: Two contacts. They were waiting inside the wreck field.

log.title: Bait
log.text: The Kestrel was a lure. Someone is farming this graveyard.

areas.name: Battle graveyard
areas.note: Dense wreckage. Salvage everywhere, line of sight is terrible.
